# SEO-345: Vary responses only on headers that change the body

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Evidence tier | `A` |
| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

The Vary header names exactly those request headers the response body actually depends on, and no others.

## Rationale

Every header named multiplies the number of stored copies, so naming one the body ignores fragments the cache into variants that can never be reused, while omitting one the body does depend on serves the wrong variant.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Determine which request headers the response generation reads and name those. Where content negotiation is driven by a header the cache cannot see, redirect to a distinct URL per variant instead of varying on it.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Request each URL with the named headers varied one at a time and confirm the body changes only for the headers listed.
- Evidence: `HTTP_HEADER`, `RENDERED_HTML`, `ROUTE`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: Varying on the user agent to serve different content to crawlers is not covered by this record and is addressed as a prohibited practice elsewhere in the registry.
